hotspots.name: Forge Coals
hotspots.description: The forge coals glow under a thin gray crust. Fresh hammer scale lies beside them, mixed with black grit from the village bread ovens.

hotspots.name: Tool Bench
hotspots.description: A bench of files, nails, and wagon irons. One fresh-cut hook matches the guardhouse rope rack, but the smith's mark has been filed away.
